generate_projects_from_build_files: run generate_projects.py with build JSON files to render Mako templates into project output files
preprocess_build_with_plugins: preprocess build JSON files using discovered Python plugins via mako_renderer.py before template rendering
render_template_files: render all .template files in the templates directory into output files using preprocessed build data
run_parallel_template_jobs: run template rendering jobs in parallel using the --jobs flag to set worker count
test_generated_output_with_diff: set TEST=true environment variable to diff generated output against expected results for regression testing
